title: The end of the HTTP byte range is included in the result
summary: bytes=0-499 specifies the first 500 bytes; bytes=-500 indicates up to 500 bytes at the end.
applies: HTTP representation and offline message parsing
detail: When calculating the length of the partial response, use the returned last-first+1; the unknown total length and the length of the segment are two quantities.
boundary: The server MAY ignore the Range and return a full 200 response, and should check the status and actual Content-Range before reassembly.
relevance: When restoring multiple download records to a single file, avoid losing a single byte at the join.
